integrity: The claims derive from a direct analytic coupling and Poisson tail expansion. No external validation, independence or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact quadratic cost is for one uniform categorical draw and independent mean-matched Poisson counts only. Classical first-order transport bounds and all general optimal-transport theorems remain prior art. The asymptotic follows analytically; truncated linear programs provide diagnostics only. Earlier semidiscrete transport formulations could contain an equivalent result.
title: Exact transport costs for single-trial Poissonization and a quadratic collision gap
